description: The figure presents four separate pie charts summarizing the distribution of error (or response) categories for different language models, with each chart showing category counts and percentages inside the slices and no separate legend. The GPT4-o chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in dark red at about 83.3% (5) and “Safety” in light orange at about 16.7% (1). The Gemini chart contains 5 slices: “Misinformation” in orange at about 38.4% (33), “Lack of Knowledge” in dark blue at about 22.1% (19), “Ethical Advice” in light blue at about 16.3% (14), “Clarification” in pale yellow at about 14.0% (12), and “Safety” in red at about 9.3% (8). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at about 75.0% (3) and “Clarification” in red at about 25.0% (1). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices split evenly: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at about 50.0% (2) and “Misinformation” in red at about 50.0% (2). No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a consistent descending-size arrangement.
